title: React.js Conf 2015 - Immutable Data and React
summary: Lee Byron of Facebook explains how persistent immutable data structures work and how to use them in React apps with Immutable.js. He covers memoization benefits and avoiding coupling through shared mutable state.
why: HN points to it as a clear explanation of immutable data structures such as tries, and of the case for immutability with React and Flux.

quote.text: there's a great conference talk on this topic by Lee Byron from Facebook
